answer: Proof-of-stake consensus functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital to validate transactions. An attacker cannot forge identity signatures without holding substantial native assets, forcing their influence toward a financial nadir if they attempt a split-brain attack. As the decentralized nebula of participating agents grows, the marginal cost of acquiring enough stake to subvert the network becomes prohibitively expensive, ensuring honest behavior is economically optimal.
